prompt: How many contacts reached each step of the 2025 sales funnel? Take the leads created in 2025 (created_at, Brussels local time). A contact is one email address, compared exactly as stored. A contact counts as with_opportunity when one of those leads has an opportunity, and as won when one of those opportunities is won. The steps need no date order: an opportunity counts whenever it was created, and a won one whenever it closed, even in a later year. Return three columns, in this order: contacts, with_opportunity and won, each a number of contacts. Return one row. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row for the whole funnel

hints: Next, write the three step counts as numbers of distinct email addresses.
A contact can have two leads, so count distinct emails, and keep only the emails whose lead has an opportunity, or a won one, for the later steps.
faded_shape:
WITH lead_steps AS (  -- one row per lead created in the period, with its opportunity if any
  SELECT l.email, o.opportunity_id, o.is_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
why_this_works: Counting distinct emails counts contacts, not leads, and the LEFT JOIN keeps the contacts whose leads never became an opportunity.
